usem.vamp.avit.sections.description: Sections of the VAMP finding payload in order, one json_key=path per line: the path is dot-walked from the application vulnerable item (empty path = the item itself, remediation_task = the item's remediation task). The fields of each section come from usem.vamp.avit.fields.<json_key>.

usem.vamp.avit.fields.finding.value:
number=number,
sys_created_on=sys_created_on,
sys_updated_on=sys_updated_on,
state=state,
cmdb_ci=configuration_item,
u_verification_status=u_verification_status,
source_avit_id=source_avit_id,
usem.vamp.avit.fields.finding.description: Fields of the finding section (sn_vul_app_vulnerable_item), one servicenow_field=json_field per line in payload order; a field missing on the table or empty is sent as "".

usem.vamp.avit.fields.tpe.description: Fields of the tpe section (third party entry, sn_vul_app_vul_entry), one servicenow_field=json_field per line.

usem.vamp.avit.fields.remediation_task.description: Fields of the remediation_task section (sn_vul_app_vulnerability), one servicenow_field=json_field per line.

usem.vamp.avit.fields.ait.description: Fields of the ait section (Primary AIT of the finding), one servicenow_field=json_field per line.

usem.vamp.avit.fields.ci.description: Fields of the ci section (configuration item of the finding), one servicenow_field=json_field per line.

usem.vamp.avit.fields.exception.description: Fields of the exception section (sn_sec_exception_change_approval), one servicenow_field=json_field per line.

usem.vamp.avit.fields.consequence.description: Fields of the consequence section, one servicenow_field=json_field per line.

usem.vamp.avit.fields.ptreq.description: Fields of the ptreq section (sn_vul_pen_test_assessment_request), one servicenow_field=json_field per line.
